we demonstrate that VQ VAE neural networks are capable to learn a quantised representation for accounting data and that the learned quantised representation can be utilised for the audit sampling of financial statement audits.

(i) the proposed neural network is able to learn a latent representation of journal entries that is capable of (ii) uncovering the underlying factors of variation and can be (iii) utilised as an effective audit sample in financial audits of financial statements.

we demonstrate, based on real-world datasets, that a VQ VAE neural network is able to learn the latent structure of accounting data and that this learned quantisation can be utilised to provide a highly representative audit sampling in financial statement auditing.

developing a novel neural network approach for the audit sampling of financial statements.
the development of a machine learning based approach for audit sampling.
the application of artificial neural networks to audit sampling and the development of an audit sampling method that learns from the underlying accounting data.
